name: Remote Receiver → On Magiquest
description: An automation to perform when a MagiQuest wand remote code has been decoded. A variable `x` of type <APIStruct text="remote_base::MagiQuestData" path="remote_base::MagiQuestData" /> is passed to the automation for use in lambdas. Since 2026.11, `x.wand_id` is the wand's full 31 bit id and `x.magnitude` its 9 bit magnitude field; earlier versions read both fields at the wrong offsets, so lambdas that compare them need the new values shown by the dumper.
